review_kind: AI-assisted source-context review of PSF calibration and processing help plus Host–Pathogen assay guidance. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.key: Enter the actual image pixel spacing in micrometers. No calibration is inferred.
records.source: Enter the actual image pixel spacing in micrometers. No calibration is inferred.
records.translation: Introduzca el espaciado real de los píxeles de la imagen en micrómetros. No se deduce ninguna calibración.

records.key: Enter the measured kernel pixel spacing. It must match the image; no resampling is performed.
records.source: Enter the measured kernel pixel spacing. It must match the image; no resampling is performed.
records.translation: Introduzca el espaciado de píxel del núcleo medido. Debe coincidir con el de la imagen; no se realiza remuestreo.

records.key: Full width at half maximum in micrometers. The Gaussian is sampled at image spacing and truncated at four sigma.
records.source: Full width at half maximum in micrometers. The Gaussian is sampled at image spacing and truncated at four sigma.
records.translation: Anchura total a la mitad del máximo en micrómetros. La gaussiana se muestrea con el espaciado de la imagen y se trunca a cuatro sigma.

records.key: Load a 2D TIFF or NPY kernel, up to 64 MiB. File and normalized-kernel hashes identify the captured data. Reload to read changed file contents.
records.source: Load a 2D TIFF or NPY kernel, up to 64 MiB. File and normalized-kernel hashes identify the captured data. Reload to read changed file contents.
records.translation: Cargue un núcleo 2D TIFF o NPY de hasta 64 MiB. Los hashes del archivo y del núcleo normalizado identifican los datos cargados. Vuelva a cargar para leer los cambios del archivo.

records.key: Read the kernel file again. A file changed on disk does not silently alter an already loaded kernel.
records.source: Read the kernel file again. A file changed on disk does not silently alter an already loaded kernel.
records.translation: Vuelva a leer el archivo del núcleo. Un archivo modificado en disco no altera de forma silenciosa un núcleo ya cargado.

records.key: Richardson–Lucy iterations. More iterations may amplify noise. This method has no regularization.
records.source: Richardson–Lucy iterations. More iterations may amplify noise. This method has no regularization.
records.translation: Iteraciones de Richardson–Lucy. Más iteraciones pueden amplificar el ruido. Este método no tiene regularización.

records.key: Order: percentile stretch (Display) → background → PSF → denoise → contrast → sharpen → detect → morphology → split.
records.source: Order: percentile stretch (Display) → background → PSF → denoise → contrast → sharpen → detect → morphology → split.
records.translation: Orden: estiramiento por percentiles (Visualización) → fondo → PSF → reducción de ruido → contraste → enfoque → detección → morfología → división.

records.key: Calculate an explicitly sampled Gaussian, or load a measured 2D kernel with odd dimensions and finite nonnegative values. The centre pixel is the origin. The loaded kernel is normalized to sum to one.
records.source: Calculate an explicitly sampled Gaussian, or load a measured 2D kernel with odd dimensions and finite nonnegative values. The centre pixel is the origin. The loaded kernel is normalized to sum to one.
records.translation: Calcule una gaussiana con muestreo explícito o cargue un núcleo 2D medido con dimensiones impares y valores finitos no negativos. El píxel central es el origen. El núcleo cargado se normaliza para que su suma sea uno.

records.key: Apply a calibrated point spread function after background subtraction. Convolution adds blur; Richardson–Lucy deconvolution can amplify noise. A Gaussian is an approximation, not a measured microscope PSF.
records.source: Apply a calibrated point spread function after background subtraction. Convolution adds blur; Richardson–Lucy deconvolution can amplify noise. A Gaussian is an approximation, not a measured microscope PSF.
records.translation: Aplique una función de dispersión de punto calibrada tras restar el fondo. La convolución añade desenfoque; la deconvolución Richardson–Lucy puede amplificar el ruido. Una gaussiana es una aproximación, no una PSF medida del microscopio.

records.key: Apply a calibrated measured PSF or an explicit Gaussian approximation to segmentation channels before normalization. Convolution adds blur; Richardson–Lucy attempts deconvolution and can amplify noise. Raw images and measurement intensities remain unchanged. Leave this off unless the same kernel and pixel calibration fit every selected channel.
records.source: Apply a calibrated measured PSF or an explicit Gaussian approximation to segmentation channels before normalization. Convolution adds blur; Richardson–Lucy attempts deconvolution and can amplify noise. Raw images and measurement intensities remain unchanged. Leave this off unless the same kernel and pixel calibration fit every selected channel.
records.translation: Aplique una PSF medida y calibrada o una aproximación gaussiana explícita a los canales de segmentación antes de normalizar. La convolución añade desenfoque; Richardson–Lucy intenta deconvolucionar y puede amplificar el ruido. Las imágenes originales y las intensidades de medición no cambian. Déjelo desactivado salvo que el mismo núcleo y la calibración de píxel sean adecuados para todos los canales seleccionados.

records.key: Relate whole vacuoles to their host cells and compare marker intensities against an explicit host reference compartment. Optional linked parasite counts describe replication; absent counts and invalid reference intensities remain unknown. Calibrate marker thresholds using assay controls.
records.source: Relate whole vacuoles to their host cells and compare marker intensities against an explicit host reference compartment. Optional linked parasite counts describe replication; absent counts and invalid reference intensities remain unknown. Calibrate marker thresholds using assay controls.
records.translation: Relacione vacuolas completas con sus células hospedadoras y compare las intensidades de los marcadores con un compartimento de referencia explícito del hospedador. Los recuentos de parásitos vinculados opcionales describen la replicación; los recuentos ausentes y las intensidades de referencia no válidas permanecen desconocidos. Calibre los umbrales de los marcadores con controles del ensayo.
